metadata.description: Self-hosting marketplace for the sessionkit plugin and the session family it installs - add with `claude plugin marketplace add <path or url>`.

plugins.name: sessionkit
plugins.description: Session Kit gives your Claude Code sessions voice, mail, a phone line and a tmux sidebar, in one install.

plugins.name: sessionmail
plugins.description: Mail for coding agents: message moves messages, pager alerts, memory is the filesystem view - three commands over one maildir.

plugins.name: sessiontools
plugins.description: The session command for coding agents: list the live sessions, read a seat's properties and context, start one from an agent file.

plugins.name: sessionphone
plugins.description: Ring your Claude Code session from your phone over Delta Chat

plugins.name: sessionview
plugins.description: A sidebar for tmux: your projects (sessions) and your agents (seats), here and on remote hosts.

plugins.name: sessionvoice
plugins.description: Ears and a mouth for a Claude Code agent: always-on listening (the room, or a phone call), a waiter that wakes the agent on the user's finished turn, and a mouth that speaks without blocking.
